recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant prose or a current-core extension for older releases. If HL7 wants to recover the historical extension promised for pre-R4 versions, treat that as Extension Pack or historical publication maintenance rather than a current FHIR core source correction.
issue_request: FHIR-13543 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It requested a way to convey the target resource type when a Reference uses a business identifier/logical reference; FHIR-I chose to add Reference.type [0..1] rather than only an extension, require consistency when Reference.reference also contains a FHIR URL, and create a same-effect extension for prior versions.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn revision 13214, commit 2319e45e4115705f873661fe217ae2971eebc13f, which added Reference.type to source/datatypes/reference.xml and a Target Type section to source/references.html. source/fhir.ini actively lists Reference under [types] and maps reference to the references page under [type-pages].
additional_context: Later final decisions refined the original application: FHIR-28411 clarified that Reference.type in FHIR resources must identify a valid non-abstract FHIR resource while logical models may refer to non-resource content; FHIR-39290 removed an over-strong comment implying references must resolve when type is present; FHIR-50574 clarified Target Type narrative; and FHIR-18059 was resolved no-change because R4 already had Reference.type. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found, and Extension Pack searches did not reveal a separate legacy Reference.type extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current build-scope Reference datatype and references page already implement the issue's current-spec effect: Reference carries target type information, logical references can include that target type, and later accepted clarifications are present.
